BLOCKERS.md.label: Blockers
BLOCKERS.md.help_text: Analyze writes this file only when planning is blocked. Answer the blocking questions directly in the document; clearing it unblocks downstream steps.
BLOCKERS.md.prompt_text: This section contains existing blocking issues for the target and the users responses to them which should address the stated concern.

COMPASS.md.label: Compass
COMPASS.md.help_text: This file is injected into every build step as orientation for the builder. Keep it brief, directive, and free of duplicated source detail.
COMPASS.md.prompt_text: This is the core intent file for the project containing user defined intent, constraints, and guardrails for the project.

ANALYZE_COMPASS.md.label: Analyze Compass
ANALYZE_COMPASS.md.help_text: This file is injected into every `drydock analyze` run for this target. Keep only brief steering: priorities, decomposition guidance, and hard constraints.
ANALYZE_COMPASS.md.prompt_text: This section provides standing user steering .  Use it as primary user feedback from a prior analysis run and adust behavior to match.

PLAN_COMPASS.md.label: Plan Compass
PLAN_COMPASS.md.help_text: This file is injected into every `drydock plan` run for this target. Use it to steer decomposition, ordering, and durable file boundaries.
PLAN_COMPASS.md.prompt_text: This section provides standing user steering .  Use it as primary user feedback from a prior analysis run and adust behavior to match.

AGENTS.md.label: Agents
AGENTS.md.help_text: Repository operating contract and execution rules.
AGENTS.md.prompt_text: This file should never be injected.  If the llm sees this prompt in a drydock command, it must report it to the user and  exit.

ANALYSIS.md.label: Analysis
ANALYSIS.md.help_text: Reviewed analysis that plan uses as its immediate decomposition basis.
ANALYSIS.md.prompt_text: This section was created by a prior analysis step - it contains a suggest list of stories you can use for planning.

ARCHITECTURE.md.label: Architecture
ARCHITECTURE.md.help_text: Architecture boundary, module layout, and system shape reference.
ARCHITECTURE.md.prompt_text: This section is the foundational architecture authority for the system.

BUILD_PLAN.md.label: Build Plan
BUILD_PLAN.md.help_text: Draft delivery plan and work ordering context.
BUILD_PLAN.md.prompt_text: This section provides delivery sequencing and work-grouping context.

BUILD_PLAN_INTENT.md.label: Build Plan Intent
BUILD_PLAN_INTENT.md.help_text: Planning intent and decomposition guidance for the target.
BUILD_PLAN_INTENT.md.prompt_text: This section provides planning intent for decomposition style, file boundaries, and work packaging.

CHANGE_LOG.md.label: Change Log
CHANGE_LOG.md.help_text: Change history and scope deltas for the target.
CHANGE_LOG.md.prompt_text: This section provides prior-change context and scope deltas only.

DATABASE.md.label: Database
DATABASE.md.help_text: Persistence design and data model authority.
DATABASE.md.prompt_text: This section is the data and persistence authority for schema-facing work.

FUNCTIONALITY.md.label: Functionality
FUNCTIONALITY.md.help_text: Capability inventory and functional scope summary.
FUNCTIONALITY.md.prompt_text: This section provides capability inventory and functional scope context, not implementation detail.

IDEAS.md.label: Ideas
IDEAS.md.help_text: Backlog, options, and candidate scope notes.
IDEAS.md.prompt_text: This section provides optional scope, backlog, and idea context. Do not treat every item as committed.

INTENT.md.label: Intent
INTENT.md.help_text: Product intent, goals, and outcome objectives.
INTENT.md.prompt_text: This section is the product-intent authority for goals and desired outcomes.

MANIFEST_CONTRACT.md.label: Manifest Contract
MANIFEST_CONTRACT.md.help_text: Prompt contract defining required MANIFEST output shape.
MANIFEST_CONTRACT.md.prompt_text: This section defines the required MANIFEST output contract. Follow it exactly.

BLUEPRINTS_CONTRACT.md.label: Blueprints Contract
BLUEPRINTS_CONTRACT.md.help_text: Prompt contract defining required Blueprint output shape.
BLUEPRINTS_CONTRACT.md.prompt_text: This section defines the required Blueprint output contract. Follow it exactly.

METADATA.md.label: Metadata
METADATA.md.help_text: Project metadata and target identity reference.
METADATA.md.prompt_text: This is project metadata and i dont think the llm should see this string - error if you do.

README.md.label: Readme
README.md.prompt_text: This section provides broad project orientation. Prefer more specific files when they exist.

SOUNDINGS.md.label: Soundings
SOUNDINGS.md.help_text: Acceptance checklist and current verification state for the target.
SOUNDINGS.md.prompt_text: This section provides acceptance and verification context. Do not invent requirements from unchecked items.

SPIKE_RESULTS.md.label: Spike Results
SPIKE_RESULTS.md.help_text: Research findings and resolved spike conclusions.
SPIKE_RESULTS.md.prompt_text: This section provides research outcomes and resolved spike conclusions. Preserve settled results.

UI-GENERAL.md.label: UI General
UI-GENERAL.md.help_text: Shared UI contract and cross-screen interface guidance.
UI-GENERAL.md.prompt_text: This section defines shared UI contract and cross-screen interface guidance.

injected_prefixes.label: Feature Contract
injected_prefixes.help_text: Feature-specific contract defining one capability boundary.
injected_prefixes.prompt_text: This section defines the named feature contract. Use it as authority for that feature's behavior and boundaries.

injected_prefixes.label: Screen Contract
injected_prefixes.help_text: Screen-specific contract defining one UI surface.
injected_prefixes.prompt_text: This section defines the named screen contract. Use it as authority for that screen's UI behavior and boundary.
